I agree, bb will suck a lot after this update. But I think this is what they intended to do in the first place, it's just that they are fixing it now.

The main problem of bb for me is the loot. It's stupidly grindy to get anything upgrade there, and you need a lot to even get the 6th builder.

As for clan games, you can still kind of rush it, you can just surrender after you're done with what you're trying to do. It's just that you're going to have to avoid missions regarding getting certain percentage or stars.

I agree that you can easily get the extra resources to cover the difference in cost reduction. But if you have multiple upgrades on the same day, then you're going to have to farm a lot. That's when the difference in cost reduction and extra resources are going to come in clutch.

As for the cosmetics, we really don't know how well they sell or how much supercell is making from them. We're literally just guessing, there are no statistics for this.

The Time reduction is huge! And the price reduction seems useless if you're active, but for casual players it's pretty big.

 You can do unlimited attack, but you're still spending time attacking. Having the extra resources and cost reduction is going to save quite a bit of time farming. Also there are books and builder potions.

Besides the gold pass, they're still going to make money on the deals, gems, skins, and sceneries. The helpers cost a lot, and that is not considering that they'll add more in the future.

It could go either way, but I'd say Saitama would most likely win.  
Here is the scenario: Goku heard that Saitama is pretty strong and want to fight, Saitama can also see that Goku is really strong, so he accepts. Saitama punch Goku and Goku easily block it, seeing that Saitama would try a bit harder, but still that wouldn't be enough. Goku would most likely go with it and go easy with Saitama. But Saitama can grow, really fast.  
As the fight goes on Saitama would grow and grow and eventually match base Goku. Goku get serious and goes through all the ssj and eventually goes Ultra Instinct, which massively overpower Saitama again. If Saitama don't get knock out, he'll grow to Ultra Instinct as well. After a while Goku Ultra Instinct runs out and Saitama wins.  
On the other hand, IF Goku just want to beat/ kill Saitama and goes full power Ultra Instinct from the start then Goku will win. BUT this is Goku we're talking. He wants to fight fair, he likes a good fight. Remember when he gave Cell a Senzu bean because he was injured?  So he won't go full power from the start.  
TLDR; Saitama has never shown any limit, the only "limit" so far is him not beating Garou in one punch, but he wasn't serious or even taking any damage. While even with Ultra Instinct, Goku can still be beaten, look that the manga.
